pretty solid extraction shooter with a fun asthetic. guns sound and feel nice so far and there is mods for most of them. the looting feels similar for the genre so they got that right. the feature i love of extraction shooting which is building and upgrading a home base is there and i do love the goal of building a ship to escape the planet. 

shotguns spread out a little too much, spreading out their damage too much at even short range. i have to be in melee range to get the full damage in. the guns unfortunately do not visually change with the mods you install on them. even the laser sight only has a laser light but not laser projector.  finally i love the base building and upgrading but unfortunately its not as satisfying as the original tarkov's home bunker for some reason. i'm not sure what it is that is making me think that. if i take a stab at it, it might be the same reason i would love to see the mods on the guns visually, i think i want to see the stations visually change as you upgrade them, starting from cobbled together spots to large advanced high tech stations.

Better than Tarkov in every way that matters. Retains the satisfying core loop of scavenging, questing, and leveling up, all while making numerous quality of life improvements, and, most importantly, completely dropping the frustration of PvP.

The game is cute and all but the AI will agro through walls and honestly sometimes it's just more work than it's worth. I'm sure there will be plenty of people who disagree but I straight up stopped having a good time after the first 3 times I got melted by some duck that I can't even see because of their awareness "features" where the game won't render in an enemy but the enemy can see and shoot you. On top of that the audio direction is all kinds of screwy and it was just an unpleasant experience. I'm sure someone will explain these "challenges" in a positive light but again, to me this is way more effort than I was looking for in a duck game.
Decided to give it a second chance and was more or less enjoying the game till I took the ferry to retrieve my body and got attack through a fence that the player cant see through but apparently the npc's can. I'm sure if I spent the time to look up tutorials, memorize or download maps, memorized NPC pathing and all that other ♥♥♥♥ it would probably be easier, but in my opinion this game isn't worth the time it wants you to put into it.
